findings.text: The requirement assumes every Python input belongs to the test import closure, but the required `common` files include modules outside it whose changes must invalidate the derivation. Fix: exclude the shared harness files from this non-invalidation requirement.

The acceptance check assumes collection imports every runtime dependency, but collecting `queryMutants` succeeds without loading `conformance.native_probe`, `conformance.native_ordering` or `conformance.native_storage`. Fix: describe collection as an import smoke check and reserve runtime dependency validation for the CI execution.
The stated measurement gives 224 conformance modules, but `modelInputs` declares 270 at the inspected base. Fix: correct the count to 270.
